output:
Kilbarrack Van Co helped me move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. It was a two-bed flat, though most of the things were mine, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. I booked through the website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut. The quote was €340 for up to four hours, with two lads and the van. They took about three and a half hours, so the price was very good compared with other quotes I got, which were over €450.

The main thing to know is that they were meant to arrive at 9 and got there around 10:30. Dessie texted at 8:40 to say the previous job had run over, which I appreciated, but I was sitting on boxes with a cold coffee for a while. Dessie knocked €40 off the price afterwards without me asking, which was a fair gesture. Being late wasn’t a disaster for me, but if you’re working around a landlord handover or another tight deadline, it’s something to factor in.

The lads were helpful once they arrived. The couch wouldn’t make the turn on the third floor, but one of them (Kev, I think) whipped an Allen key out of his pocket, took the legs off and got it through straight away. They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want anymore. Those little things made the move easier, especially with all the stairs.

One thing I was sorry about was that the brass base of a floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets, but the lamp wasn’t, and it belonged to my nanny, so I was gutted. I know things can happen during a move, but I’d say to make sure lamps and other delicate bits are wrapped too.

Overall, the move was good value and the crew were practical and helpful. I’d use them again, but I’d be clear about timing if I had a strict deadline and would ask for fragile items to be wrapped. Four stars feels fair: mostly a good experience, with a couple of things worth knowing before you book.
